title: 母版/版式列表项
description: Layout rail 母版与版式 list: each row selects a layout or the master as the editing surface. A row is a select control; the master is listed first, with its thumbnail, name and 母版 tag.

kimiUi.appearsWhen: on a layout or master surface

preconditions.notes: Entered first with 编辑版式 on page 5 (正文).

steps: 点击「母版与版式」列表中的一个版式或母版

pptd.summary: selecting a layout row changes the editor surface only; the PPTD document stays unchanged

selfTestChecklist: a list row selects its layout or the master
